AMENDMENT 
 
 to the Loan Agreement dated 13 th day of May 2019 (“Loan Agreement”), by and between 
 
 Zameen Venture One (Private) Limited (“ Lender ”) and Zameen Alpha (Private) Limited (“ Borrower ”) 
 
 [Each a “ Party ” and, collectively, “ Parties ”] 
 
 This Amendment (“ Amendment ”) to the Loan Agreement , is made and entered into at Lahore on this 1 2 th day of May 2020 (“ Execution Date ”), by and between the Parties. 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows: 
 
 The Amendment shall be effective from the Execution Date. 
 
 The term for utilization of the Credit Facility , as referred in Clause 2 of the Loan Agreement , shall be increased from one (1) year to five (5) years. The Borrower may utilize the Credit Facility as per its requirements, at the Borrower’s option through direct or indirect payments, transfer of funds or, direct payments made to or on behalf of the Borrower, from time to time, up to a maximum of the Credit Limit . 
 
 This Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Loan Agreement. 
 
 All other terms and provisions in the Loan Agreement shall apply mutatis mutandis and shall continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event of any conflict, the provisions of this Amendment shall prevail and any conflicting term in the Loan Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately. 
 
 All expressions and terms defined or used in the Loan Agreement shall bear the same meaning in this Amendment, unless otherwise specified.
